Name: Rattan Daybed Mod
Author: BlaiseLeone
Description:
Just because you live in a one-room cottage doesn't mean you have to live like a pleb.
It doesn't change the kid's beds. It does change the bed in Robin's shop tho. 

I really liked the idea of having a couch/daybed instead of a single bed in the un-upgraded farmhouse - so after a bunch of trials I think I figured out how to make a simple bed-replacement mod. I figured I'd share it, because if I wanted it, some of you all might as well. 

The fireplace, hutch, and side chair are designed by me - but don't have a mod for them yet if you're interested HMU

I am a graphic designer, with a mac, and minimal coding experience in coding so this is my first Stardew Mod. I've essentially designed a whole furniture catalog of rattan furniture for Stardew at this point, but want to make sure I (sort of) know what I'm doing before I take that leap.

Downloads.Description: Replaces the default single bed with a boho-esq rattan day bed.
